# OregonLive.com

> > OregonLive.com is Oregon's premier news and information portal, featuring local news, sports, entertainment, and comprehensive auto classifieds for the Portland metro area and statewide communities.

OregonLive.com serves as the digital home of The Oregonian, providing breaking news, investigative journalism, and community resources for Oregon residents. The platform includes extensive automotive marketplace features connecting buyers and sellers throughout the state.
